chapter.title: First Paychecks: Hauling
chapter.summary: Move cargo for Covalex and climb its Hauling ladder to Member.

objectives.title: Covalex: "Opportunity for Independent Cargo Hauler"
objectives.why: Covalex's intro contract. Its 50 reputation alone takes you from Trainee to Rookie.

steps.do: Accept "Opportunity for Independent Cargo Hauler" in Contracts.
steps.done_when: It is in your ACCEPTED tab.

steps.do: Collect the cargo from the pickup freight elevator and load it on your ship (tractor beam or by hand).
steps.done_when: The cargo is on your ship's grid.

steps.do: Fly to the drop-off and send the cargo down its freight elevator.

objectives.title: Reach Covalex Junior (250 rep)
objectives.why: A "Trainee Rank" haul gives 500 reputation, enough for Junior in one run. "Rookie Rank" hauls give only 50 (about 4 runs).

steps.do: Accept a Covalex "Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul" or "Trainee Rank - Direct Small Cargo Haul".
Deliver it the same way as the intro.
steps.done_when: Contracts now offers "Junior Rank" Covalex hauls.

objectives.title: Reach Covalex Member (5,250 rep)
objectives.why: Junior Rank hauls give 500 reputation each and pay about 60,000-77,000 aUEC.

steps.do: Take Covalex "Junior Rank" hauls that fit your ship's cargo grid. Count each one here.

objectives.title: Red Wind: "Red Wind Seeking New Haulers"
objectives.why: Opens a second hauling company. Its 100 reputation takes Red Wind's Hauling ladder from Trainee to Rookie.

steps.do: Accept "Red Wind Seeking New Haulers" and deliver it.

objectives.title: Ling: "Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling"
objectives.why: Ling Family Hauling's intro. Only offered while you are a Ling Trainee, and gives 100 Hauling reputation.

steps.do: Accept "Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling" and deliver it.

objectives.title: Courier intros for Red Wind and Ling
objectives.why: Package-delivery intros that start each company's Courier career (+100 Courier reputation each).

steps.do: Accept and finish "Red Wind Seeking New Pilots".
Accept and finish "Ling Family Seeking New Contractors".
